actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +3, range 100/400 ft. _Hit:_ 12 (2d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: _Trigger:_ The warrior is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The warrior adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. ## Water Elemental
